method: Every English article was separately reread against its Korean original by one of three GPT-6.1 Sol agents at medium reasoning effort. Automated checks additionally verify metadata, code, links, images, heading anchors, routes, feeds and UI behavior.

sourceCaveats.detail: Original teaching simplifications retained, including bcrypt described as encryption, JWT as a one-time encrypted token, and unconditional .env protection language; fenced code and its Korean comments remain verbatim.
Original simplified claims about full HTML reloads, lifecycle timing, effect execution, and useCallback preventing Child rerenders are preserved rather than silently corrected.

Original blanket stack/heap explanation and object-allocation claims are preserved. Original malformed bold marker around Integer.valueOf and missing operators in an arithmetic list are also retained.
Original min/mid naming inconsistency and closest-index/insertion explanation preserved.
Original inconsistent complexity claim says path compression reduces O(log N) to O(N), despite earlier near-O(1) wording; translated exactly in meaning.
The today/tomorrow/Eden line is an intentional Korean sound-based joke; retained the backend cohort member Eden reference, though its wordplay cannot carry over directly.
Korean speech literals 안녕하세요 / 안녕 / 하세요 are preserved because the actual split is essential to the example; an English hello gloss explains them.
Large runs of HTML line breaks preserved from original.
Original unmatched quotation punctuation in the feedback block retained alongside its Markdown structure.
Pre-existing sample separately reread against its Korean original; no change required.

Original claims that display:none removes elements from the DOM and that every child re-renders on Context value changes are retained as written, not fact-corrected. Original inline triple backticks in the backtick explanation are preserved.

Original overview says Carol calculates gxz and gxy, whereas its later detailed process says gxz and gyz; retained the original discrepancy. No protocol execution or independent verification was performed.
Original simplified statements about function scope, this, and garbage collection are retained; fenced examples including Korean comments remain verbatim.
Original malformed GitHub link markup and the stated content-table name are retained. Docker/JVM analogy and generalizations are translated faithfully.
Original remaining-array example omits 10 despite the stated removals; retained that numeric discrepancy.
Original describes the response receiver as a server, mentions GET among body-relevant methods, and spells applcation/json that way in prose; retained these claims/typo.
Bug bounty amounts are historical claims in the supplied post and were not independently refreshed. Image caption dates were translated without changing image paths.
Original uses a plain Queue while claiming O(E log V) complexity and optimization via priority queue; retained those claims.
Original calls The Light in Your Eyes a film; retained its wording.
Original String/StringBuilder memory-allocation simplifications and trailing slash in the delete heading are retained.
Original gloss equates removal with not enqueuing and gives a simplified in-degree explanation; retained as written.
Original unusual adjacent emphasis markers in the long quotation are preserved.
Original institution abbreviation 한예고 is ambiguous; Hanyego avoids inventing an expansion.
Preserved the source’s bare generic/type-like HTML text, command headings, list structure, and Git implementation claims without technical correction.
Preserved the original claim that Number exactly represents integers from -2^63 to 2^63-1; preserved the loosely formatted undefined/null comparison and unfenced example structure.
Preserved the original JWT simplifications and claims about encrypted signatures, Base64, forced logout, and stolen-token handling; translation is not a technical revision.
Korean organization names remain intentionally in the aside explaining that their Korean spellings contain no spaces. Team nickname 유루이흑넛 is romanized phonetically.
Preserved the source’s broad claim that Dijkstra has lower time complexity than DFS/BFS rather than silently correcting it.
Preserved original arithmetic 100,000 × 100,000 = one billion and malformed bold spans with a space before closing **.
The original contains Korean prose quotations inside fenced blocks. These remain verbatim because exact fenced-code preservation was explicitly required.
Preserved the original statement describing starting/destination/intermediate nodes as infinity, without rewriting it into a different technical claim.
Preserved the original switches between left/right and upper/lower cells, and row/column terminology.
Preserved all-prose-as-H2 structure and malformed Markdown image excerpts in description; description image paths contain spaces in the source and remain unchanged.
Preserved original combinations/permutations terminology inconsistency and repeated H2 headings.
Preserved the source’s contradictory sentence “not Response DTOs, only Response DTOs” and generalized Jackson/record explanations without technical correction.
Preserved original memory-leak and nested-class assertions, including the awkward instruction to manage static.
Preserved the source’s claim that humans alone among mammals get herniated discs as a reported book claim, not an independently verified fact.
The opening 내 불쾌했다 appears malformed; rendered conservatively as “I felt uncomfortable.”
